en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: This update adds six distinct color themes, grouped extension settings, private activity refresh, protected recent alert history and complete small icon assets. Background assistance now includes on-demand, continuous and adjustable periodic options. Please test theme switching, activity interactions, viewing protection, notification timing and background behavior.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 本次更新提供六套不同配色，将附加设置集中至扩展，加入活动内后台刷新、受保护的近期提醒记录，并补齐小尺寸图标资源。后台辅助支持按需、持续及可调间歇模式。请验证配色切换、活动点击、查看保护、通知时机和后台表现。
